filter_contract.product_code: exact Code Map product code; All/blank means all
filter_contract.product_name: exact Code Map product name; All/blank means all
filter_contract.machine: exact OEE machine; All/blank means all
filter_contract.oee_include_rule: When Machine is All, include only Include in Overall = Y. When a specific machine is selected, include all matching machine records, matching the workbook KPI Calc criteria.

downtime.dmr_coding_total_hours: SUM(DMR Coding downtime_hours); separate from DMR Production total
downtime.breakdown_count: COUNT(DMR Production rows where category = BD)
downtime.mtbf_hours: (Productivity planned run hours - DMR Production downtime hours) / BD count
downtime.downtime_pct: DMR Production downtime hours / Productivity planned run hours

hourly_production.hour_attainment: actual_tins / target_tins; null when target is zero or blank
hourly_production.cumulative_target: sum target_tins for same date, module and product code through the current hour
hourly_production.cumulative_actual: sum actual_tins for same date, module and product code through the current hour; source contract keeps blank current actual blank

production_summary.days_logged: COUNT(DISTINCT production_date) where day_has_data is true
production_summary.rows_below_95_percent: COUNT saved rows where attainment < 0.95, matching the source dashboard formula

schedule_summary.source: existing permission-checked Production Schedule summary function

yield_log.source: TFI2 Product Entry records + Yield Map Master Data + KPI Setup M2 + DMR Production for the source-mapped SUMIFS formula
yield_log.calculation: Recalculate the source-mapped formula dependencies on read; never persist formula outputs into operational Product Entry records.
yield_log.yield_target_note: The source Yield Map marks the non-DPGP 95% targets as placeholders; the source instruction is returned to clients.
yield_log.live_data_acceptance: Pending; Product Entry and DMR Production currently have zero active source rows.
